服务

消息确认服务 AsamMessageBox

以 Promise 驱动提示、确认和文本输入流程。

使用场景 ​

以 Promise 驱动提示、确认和文本输入流程。

提示、确认和输入验证 ​

每个 Promise 均处理取消；输入框通过 inputPattern 校验，成功展示返回值。

提示、确认和输入验证

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="actions">
		<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="active" native-type="button" @click="alert">
			提示
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="active" native-type="button" @click="confirm">
			确认归档
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="active" native-type="button" @click="prompt">
			输入名称
		</AsamButton>
	</div>
	<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }}</p>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamMessageBoxBasicDemo' });
import { ref, onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const result = ref('等待操作');
const active = ref(false);
const alert = async () => {
	active.value = true;
	try {
		await AsamMessageBox.alert('本地草稿已保存', '提示', { buttonSize: 'big' });
		result.value = '已阅读';
	} catch {
		result.value = '提示关闭';
	} finally {
		active.value = false;
	}
};
const confirm = async () => {
	active.value = true;
	try {
		await AsamMessageBox.confirm('确认归档这条记录？', '归档确认', {
			distinguishCancelAndClose: true,
			buttonSize: 'small'
		});
		result.value = '已确认归档';
	} catch (action) {
		result.value = String(action);
	} finally {
		active.value = false;
	}
};
const prompt = async () => {
	active.value = true;
	try {
		const data = await AsamMessageBox.prompt('请输入至少两个字的名称', '命名', {
			inputPattern: /^.{2,}$/,
			inputErrorMessage: '名称至少两个字',
			buttonSize: 'large'
		});
		result.value = data.value;
	} catch {
		result.value = '输入已取消';
	} finally {
		active.value = false;
	}
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	if (active.value) AsamMessageBox.close();
});
</script>

<style scoped>
.actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	align-items: center;
}

.panel {
	padding: var(--asam-space-lg);
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

消息框与内建按钮颜色 ​

消息框与内建按钮颜色

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="colors">
		<AsamButton
			v-for="entry in types"
			:key="entry.value"
			type="default"
			:disabled="openedHere"
			@click="open(entry.value, entry.label)"
		>
			{{ entry.label }}（{{ entry.value || '空值' }}）
		</AsamButton>
	</div>
	<p role="status">{{ result }}</p>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamMessageBoxOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const types = [
	{ value: '', label: '默认' },
	{ value: 'primary', label: '主要' },
	{ value: 'success', label: '成功' },
	{ value: 'info', label: '信息' },
	{ value: 'warning', label: '警告' },
	{ value: 'error', label: '错误' }
] satisfies { value: NonNullable<AsamMessageBoxOptions['type']>; label: string }[];
const result = shallowRef('等待操作');
const openedHere = shallowRef(false);

function closeOwned() {
	if (openedHere.value) AsamMessageBox.close();
}

async function open(type: NonNullable<AsamMessageBoxOptions['type']>, label: string) {
	openedHere.value = true;
	try {
		await AsamMessageBox.confirm('检查状态图标与内建动作按钮。', label, {
			type,
			confirmButtonText: '确认',
			cancelButtonText: '取消',
			confirmButtonType: type === 'error' ? 'danger' : type || 'primary',
			cancelButtonType: 'default'
		});
		result.value = '已确认';
	} catch {
		result.value = '已取消';
	} finally {
		openedHere.value = false;
	}
}

onBeforeUnmount(closeOwned);
</script>

<style scoped>
.colors {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	align-items: center;
}
</style>

使用约定 ​

消息框提供通用调用与 alert、confirm、prompt 快捷入口，并返回 Promise。 完整说明。

宿主 AppContext 与简写重载 ​

三个快捷方法均支持 (message, options?, appContext?) 和 (message, title, options?, appContext?)。 完整说明。

宿主应用可在挂载前完成配置：

js
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import App from './App.vue';

const app = createApp(App);
app.provide('asam-message-box-context', '当前应用提供的内容');
app.use(AsamMessageBox);
app.mount('#app');

以下完整 TS/JS 示例可切换 alert、confirm、prompt 与两种重载。取消和卸载只调用本例 message 动作的 cancel，使本例 Promise 结算；不全局关闭其他业务的弹层。

宿主 AppContext 与简写重载

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="actions">
		<label>
			<span>服务类型</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="method" :disabled="active">
				<AsamOption value="alert" :label="'alert'">alert</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="confirm" :label="'确认'">确认</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="prompt" :label="'prompt'">prompt</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</label>
		<label>
			<span>上下文</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="contextMode" :disabled="active">
				<AsamOption value="explicit" :label="'显式当前 AppContext'">
					显式当前 AppContext
				</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="installed" :label="'安装服务的默认上下文'">
					安装服务的默认上下文
				</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="null" :label="'显式 null'">显式 null</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</label>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" :disabled="active" @click="open(false)">
			使用 options 简写
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" :disabled="active" @click="open(true)">
			使用 title 重载
		</AsamButton>
	</div>
	<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }}</p>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamMessageBoxServiceContextDemo' });
import { defineComponent, getCurrentInstance, h, inject, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamButton, AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamMessageBoxActionHandlers, AsamMessageBoxOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const context = getCurrentInstance()?.appContext;
const method = ref<'alert' | 'confirm' | 'prompt'>('alert');
const contextMode = ref<'explicit' | 'installed' | 'null'>('explicit');
const active = ref(false);
const result = ref('等待操作');
let cancelOwned: (() => void) | undefined;
const Content = defineComponent({
	setup() {
		const label = inject<string>('asam-message-box-context', '未设置宿主 provide');
		return () => h('span', { 'data-context-label': '' }, label);
	}
});
const cancel = () => cancelOwned?.();
const open = async (withTitle: boolean) => {
	if (active.value) return;
	active.value = true;
	result.value = '等待确认';
	const message = ({ cancel }: AsamMessageBoxActionHandlers) => {
		cancelOwned = cancel;
		return h('div', [
			h(Content),
			h(
				AsamButton,
				{ type: 'default', nativeType: 'button', onClick: cancel },
				'取消本例弹层'
			)
		]);
	};
	const options: AsamMessageBoxOptions = {
		buttonSize: 'default',
		inputPlaceholder: '输入本次确认值',
		distinguishCancelAndClose: true
	};
	const appContext =
		contextMode.value === 'installed'
			? undefined
			: contextMode.value === 'null'
				? null
				: context;
	try {
		const value = withTitle
			? await AsamMessageBox[method.value](message, '宿主上下文', options, appContext)
			: await AsamMessageBox[method.value](message, options, appContext);
		result.value =
			method.value === 'prompt' ? `confirmed: ${value.value}` : `resolved: ${value}`;
	} catch (action) {
		result.value = `rejected: ${String(action)}`;
	} finally {
		cancelOwned = undefined;
		active.value = false;
	}
};
onBeforeUnmount(cancel);
</script>

	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

<style scoped>

	margin-block: 16px;

</style>

完整用法 ​

以下用法使用本库公开入口。每个示例提供完整 TS/JS SFC，参数、事件、插槽和实例类型见本页 API。服务实例由创建方负责关闭；HTML 内容仅用于调用方已知的可信字符串。

提示与确认结果 ​

提示与确认结果

展开源码
许可场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="open">点击打开消息框</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamMessage,
	AsamMessageBox,
	type AsamMessageBoxAction as Action,
	type AsamMessageHandler
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.alert('这是一条消息。', '标题', {
		// if you want to disable its autofocus
		// autofocus: false,
		confirmButtonText: '确认',
		callback: (action: Action) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: `操作结果：${action}`
				})
			);
		}
	}).catch((action) => {
		if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
	});
};

const ownedAsamMessage = new Set<AsamMessageHandler>();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle: AsamMessageHandler) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

vue
<template>
	<div class="flex flex-wrap demo-gap">
		<AsamButton type="default" class="!ml-0" @click="open">普通 VNode</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" class="!ml-0" @click="open1">动态属性</AsamButton>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamMessageBox, AsamSwitch } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { h, ref } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox({
		title: '消息',
		message: h('p', null, [
			h('span', null, '消息内容可以使用 '),
			h('i', { style: 'color: teal' }, 'VNode')
		])
	}).catch((action) => {
		if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
	});
};

const open1 = () => {
	const checked = ref<boolean | string | number>(false);
	AsamMessageBox({
		title: '消息',
		// Should pass a function if VNode contains dynamic props
		message: () =>
			h(AsamSwitch, {
				modelValue: checked.value,
				'onUpdate:modelValue': (val: boolean | string | number) => {
					checked.value = val;
				}
			})
	}).catch((action) => {
		if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
	});
};
</script>

展开源码

vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="open">点击打开消息框</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamMessage, AsamMessageBox, type AsamMessageHandler } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

import { h } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.confirm(
		({ confirm, cancel, close }) => {
			return h('div', [
				h('p', { style: 'margin-bottom: 8px' }, '自定义按钮使用消息框操作处理器'),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'default',
						onClick: () => {
							confirm();
						}
					},
					() => '完成（resolve）'
				),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'danger',
						onClick: () => {
							cancel();
						}
					},
					() => '拒绝（reject）'
				),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'default',
						text: true,
						onClick: () => {
							close();
						}
					},
					() => '关闭（close）'
				)
			]);
		},
		{
			title: '消息',
			showConfirmButton: false,
			showCancelButton: false,
			distinguishCancelAndClose: true
		}
	)
		.then((action) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'success',
					message: `resolved: ${action}`
				})
			);
		})
		.catch((reason) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'error',
					message: `rejected: ${reason}`
				})
			);
		});
};

const ownedAsamMessage = new Set<AsamMessageHandler>();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle: AsamMessageHandler) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="open">点击打开消息框</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamMessage, AsamMessageBox, type AsamMessageHandler } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

import { h } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox({
		title: '消息',
		message: h('p', null, [
			h('span', null, '消息内容可以使用 '),
			h('i', { style: 'color: teal' }, 'VNode')
		]),
		showCancelButton: true,
		confirmButtonText: '确认',
		cancelButtonText: '取消',
		beforeClose: (action, instance, done) => {
			if (action === 'confirm') {
				instance.confirmButtonLoading = true;
				instance.confirmButtonText = '加载中……';
				setTimeout(() => {
					done();
					setTimeout(() => {
						instance.confirmButtonLoading = false;
					}, 300);
				}, 3000);
			} else {
				done();
			}
		}
	})
		.then((action) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: `操作结果：${action}`
				})
			);
		})
		.catch((action) => {
			if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
		});
};

const ownedAsamMessage = new Set<AsamMessageHandler>();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle: AsamMessageHandler) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

区分取消与关闭

展开源码
许可场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="open">点击打开消息框</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamMessage,
	AsamMessageBox,
	type AsamMessageBoxAction as Action,
	type AsamMessageHandler
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.confirm('有未保存的修改，是否保存并继续？', '确认', {
		distinguishCancelAndClose: true,
		confirmButtonText: '保存',
		cancelButtonText: '放弃修改'
	})
		.then(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: '修改已保存，即将前往新页面。'
				})
			);
		})
		.catch((action: Action) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: action === 'cancel' ? '已放弃修改，即将前往新页面。' : '留在当前页面'
				})
			);
		});
};

const ownedAsamMessage = new Set<AsamMessageHandler>();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle: AsamMessageHandler) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

	AsamMessageBox.confirm('此操作将永久删除文件，确定继续吗？', '警告', {
		confirmButtonText: '确认',
		cancelButtonText: '取消',
		type: 'warning',
		draggable: true
	})
		.then(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'success',
					message: '删除成功'
				})
			);
		})
		.catch(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: '已取消删除'
				})
			);
		});
};

const open2 = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.confirm('此操作将永久删除文件，确定继续吗？', '警告', {
		confirmButtonText: '确认',
		cancelButtonText: '取消',
		type: 'warning',
		draggable: true,
		overflow: true
	})
		.then(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'success',
					message: '删除成功'
				})
			);
		})
		.catch(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: '已取消删除'
				})
			);
		});
};

const open3 = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.confirm('此消息框使用自定义拖拽样式，拖动它即可查看效果。', '自定义拖拽样式', {
		confirmButtonText: '确认',
		cancelButtonText: '取消',
		type: 'info',
		draggable: true,
		customClass: 'custom-dragging-message-box'
	})
		.then(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'success',
					message: '操作完成'
				})
			);
		})
		.catch(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: '已取消操作'
				})
			);
		});
};

const ownedAsamMessage = new Set<AsamMessageHandler>();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle: AsamMessageHandler) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';

const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('basic/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>

<template>
	<div class="actions">
		<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="active" native-type="button" @click="alert">
			提示
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="active" native-type="button" @click="confirm">
			确认归档
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="active" native-type="button" @click="prompt">
			输入名称
		</AsamButton>
	</div>
	<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }}</p>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamMessageBoxBasicDemo' });
import { ref, onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const result = ref('等待操作');
const active = ref(false);
const alert = async () => {
	active.value = true;
	try {
		await AsamMessageBox.alert('本地草稿已保存', '提示', { buttonSize: 'big' });
		result.value = '已阅读';
	} catch {
		result.value = '提示关闭';
	} finally {
		active.value = false;
	}
};
const confirm = async () => {
	active.value = true;
	try {
		await AsamMessageBox.confirm('确认归档这条记录？', '归档确认', {

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamMessageBoxOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const types = [
	{ value: '', label: '默认' },
	{ value: 'primary', label: '主要' },
	{ value: 'success', label: '成功' },
	{ value: 'info', label: '信息' },
	{ value: 'warning', label: '警告' },
	{ value: 'error', label: '错误' }
] satisfies { value: NonNullable<AsamMessageBoxOptions['type']>; label: string }[];
const result = shallowRef('等待操作');
const openedHere = shallowRef(false);

function closeOwned() {
	if (openedHere.value) AsamMessageBox.close();
}

async function open(type: NonNullable<AsamMessageBoxOptions['type']>, label: string) {
	openedHere.value = true;
	try {
		await AsamMessageBox.confirm('检查状态图标与内建动作按钮。', label, {
			type,
			confirmButtonText: '确认',
			cancelButtonText: '取消',
			confirmButtonType: type === 'error' ? 'danger' : type || 'primary',
			cancelButtonType: 'default'
		});
		result.value = '已确认';
	} catch {
		result.value = '已取消';
	} finally {
		openedHere.value = false;
	}
}

onBeforeUnmount(closeOwned);
</script>

<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="open">点击打开消息框</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamMessage,
	AsamMessageBox,
	type AsamMessageBoxAction as Action,
	type AsamMessageHandler
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.alert('这是一条消息。', '标题', {
		// if you want to disable its autofocus
		// autofocus: false,
		confirmButtonText: '确认',
		callback: (action: Action) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: `操作结果：${action}`
				})
			);
		}
	}).catch((action) => {
		if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
	});
};

const ownedAsamMessage = new Set<AsamMessageHandler>();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle: AsamMessageHandler) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

<template>
	<div class="flex flex-wrap demo-gap">
		<AsamButton type="default" class="!ml-0" @click="open">普通 VNode</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" class="!ml-0" @click="open1">动态属性</AsamButton>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamMessageBox, AsamSwitch } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { h, ref } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox({
		title: '消息',
		message: h('p', null, [
			h('span', null, '消息内容可以使用 '),
			h('i', { style: 'color: teal' }, 'VNode')
		])
	}).catch((action) => {
		if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
	});
};

const open1 = () => {
	const checked = ref<boolean | string | number>(false);
	AsamMessageBox({
		title: '消息',
		// Should pass a function if VNode contains dynamic props
		message: () =>
			h(AsamSwitch, {
				modelValue: checked.value,
				'onUpdate:modelValue': (val: boolean | string | number) => {
					checked.value = val;
				}
			})
	}).catch((action) => {
		if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
	});
};
</script>

<style scoped>
/* Keep layout utilities local so the downloaded SFC needs no CSS preset. */

.flex-wrap {
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.demo-gap {
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}
</style>

	<div class="flex flex-wrap demo-gap">
		<AsamButton type="default" class="!ml-0" @click="open">普通 VNode</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" class="!ml-0" @click="open1">动态属性</AsamButton>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamMessageBox, AsamSwitch } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { h, ref } from 'vue';
const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox({
		title: '消息',
		message: h('p', null, [
			h('span', null, '消息内容可以使用 '),
			h('i', { style: 'color: teal' }, 'VNode')
		])
	}).catch((action) => {
		if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
	});
};
const open1 = () => {
	const checked = ref(false);
	AsamMessageBox({
		title: '消息',
		// Should pass a function if VNode contains dynamic props
		message: () =>
			h(AsamSwitch, {
				modelValue: checked.value,
				'onUpdate:modelValue': (val) => {
					checked.value = val;
				}
			})
	}).catch((action) => {
		if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
	});
};
</script>

<style scoped>
/* Keep layout utilities local so the downloaded SFC needs no CSS preset. */
.flex {
	display: flex;
}
.flex-wrap {
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.demo-gap {
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}
</style>

vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="open">点击打开消息框</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamMessage, AsamMessageBox, type AsamMessageHandler } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

import { h } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.confirm(
		({ confirm, cancel, close }) => {
			return h('div', [
				h('p', { style: 'margin-bottom: 8px' }, '自定义按钮使用消息框操作处理器'),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'default',
						onClick: () => {
							confirm();
						}
					},
					() => '完成（resolve）'
				),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'danger',
						onClick: () => {
							cancel();
						}
					},
					() => '拒绝（reject）'
				),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'default',
						text: true,
						onClick: () => {
							close();
						}
					},
					() => '关闭（close）'
				)
			]);
		},
		{
			title: '消息',
			showConfirmButton: false,
			showCancelButton: false,
			distinguishCancelAndClose: true
		}
	)
		.then((action) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'success',
					message: `resolved: ${action}`
				})
			);
		})
		.catch((reason) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'error',
					message: `rejected: ${reason}`
				})
			);
		});
};

const ownedAsamMessage = new Set<AsamMessageHandler>();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle: AsamMessageHandler) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

};

};

});

vue
<template>
	<div class="actions">
		<label>
			<span>服务类型</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="method" :disabled="active">
				<AsamOption value="alert" :label="'alert'">alert</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="confirm" :label="'确认'">确认</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="prompt" :label="'prompt'">prompt</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</label>
		<label>
			<span>上下文</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="contextMode" :disabled="active">
				<AsamOption value="explicit" :label="'显式当前 AppContext'">
					显式当前 AppContext
				</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="installed" :label="'安装服务的默认上下文'">
					安装服务的默认上下文
				</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="null" :label="'显式 null'">显式 null</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</label>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" :disabled="active" @click="open(false)">
			使用 options 简写
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" :disabled="active" @click="open(true)">
			使用 title 重载
		</AsamButton>
	</div>
	<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }}</p>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamMessageBoxServiceContextDemo' });
import { defineComponent, getCurrentInstance, h, inject, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamButton, AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamMessageBoxActionHandlers, AsamMessageBoxOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const context = getCurrentInstance()?.appContext;
const method = ref<'alert' | 'confirm' | 'prompt'>('alert');
const contextMode = ref<'explicit' | 'installed' | 'null'>('explicit');
const active = ref(false);
const result = ref('等待操作');
let cancelOwned: (() => void) | undefined;
const Content = defineComponent({
	setup() {
		const label = inject<string>('asam-message-box-context', '未设置宿主 provide');
		return () => h('span', { 'data-context-label': '' }, label);
	}
});
const cancel = () => cancelOwned?.();
const open = async (withTitle: boolean) => {
	if (active.value) return;
	active.value = true;
	result.value = '等待确认';
	const message = ({ cancel }: AsamMessageBoxActionHandlers) => {
		cancelOwned = cancel;
		return h('div', [
			h(Content),
			h(
				AsamButton,
				{ type: 'default', nativeType: 'button', onClick: cancel },
				'取消本例弹层'
			)
		]);
	};
	const options: AsamMessageBoxOptions = {
		buttonSize: 'default',
		inputPlaceholder: '输入本次确认值',
		distinguishCancelAndClose: true
	};
	const appContext =
		contextMode.value === 'installed'
			? undefined
			: contextMode.value === 'null'
				? null
				: context;
	try {
		const value = withTitle
			? await AsamMessageBox[method.value](message, '宿主上下文', options, appContext)
			: await AsamMessageBox[method.value](message, options, appContext);
		result.value =
			method.value === 'prompt' ? `confirmed: ${value.value}` : `resolved: ${value}`;
	} catch (action) {
		result.value = `rejected: ${String(action)}`;
	} finally {
		cancelOwned = undefined;
		active.value = false;
	}
};
onBeforeUnmount(cancel);
</script>
<style scoped>
.actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

# AsamMessageBox 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

## Component compatibility sources and build helpers

Cascader, Image, ImageViewer and Anchor delegate their basic public behavior to
the installed Element Plus 2.14.7 components. ASAM supplies its styles and
documented advanced value adapters; it does not carry derived setup/render
implementations, bounded zoom, keyboard focus patches or Anchor scroll handling.

The former compatibility implementations used Element Plus gitHead
`77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`. Their original source identities
are retained here for historical provenance: the Cascader distribution module
SHA256 was `bac94ed4602841106d134f39056fdaca0d7fbb711fc8ff4339b7fac65391ea82`;
Anchor source `packages/components/anchor/src/anchor.vue` SHA256 was
`3a60f68d455f3e582ecffd4639c78ee24fcbf0a2bcfe0ce0cddf03583d78af2f`.
These historical identities do not imply that the derived runtime remains in
this native-delegation candidate. The original Element Plus license follows.

Build helper inputs are pinned to VueUse core 15.0.0, Element Plus Icons Vue
2.3.2 and Lodash ES 4.18.1. Other components may still use these helpers;
removing the four derived implementations does not remove their notices.

following original notices remain applicable to retained source and helper
inputs; the installed Element Plus components and Vue remain peer dependencies.

## Private declaration snapshots

The normal declaration build redistributes 590 Element Plus 2.14.7 ES declarations
and 295 Element Plus Icons Vue 2.3.2 declarations under `dist/_upstream`.
The original declaration and producer-patch hashes, module-path adaptations and
output hashes are recorded in `dist/_upstream/provenance.json` and the build input
`tools/eng-006/upstream-declarations.lock.json`. The fixed Element Plus source
identity is `77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`.

Eight Element Plus declarations receive the recorded strong-type corrections.
Relative declaration references use explicit NodeNext extensions. The Color
class, installation key, table placeholder key and loading directive declaration
are exact re-exports of the original peer declaration leaves, preserving private
member and unique-symbol identity. These snapshots have no runtime entry point.

The complete original MIT licenses are redistributed with each declaration
snapshot at `dist/_upstream/element-plus/LICENSE` and
`dist/_upstream/icons-vue/LICENSE`. The Element Plus and Icons Vue copyright and
license texts above also apply to these declaration derivatives. External type
providers remain normal installed dependencies; their declarations are not
copied into these snapshots.

用法与契约补充说明 ​

宿主 AppContext 与简写重载 ​

三个快捷方法均支持 (message, options?, appContext?) 和 (message, title, options?, appContext?)。省略 options 时可用 (message, undefined, appContext)；省略 title 而保留 options 时用 (message, undefined, options, appContext)。显式 AppContext 使 VNode 内容能读取对应应用的 provide；省略或传 undefined 使用 app.use(AsamMessageBox) 安装时记录的默认上下文。显式 null 直接交给底层服务，不使用 ASAM 安装默认值；宿主另行配置的底层服务默认回退仍保留。

更多参数与事件说明 ​

使用约定 ​

AsamMessageBox(options, appContext?) 或 alert/confirm/prompt(message, titleOrOptions?, optionsOrContext?, appContext?) 返回 Promise。确认 resolve；取消或关闭 reject，distinguishCancelAndClose 可区分 cancel/close。prompt 成功数据包含 value 与 action；必须处理取消分支。beforeClose(action, instance, done) 可异步拦截提交，callback 是回调模式。buttonSize 使用 ASAM large/big/default/small 控件密度，弹层本身不使用这组 size。close 是全局关闭 API，本例仅在自己发起的弹层存活时清理。

组合职责与生命周期 ​

message 函数可接收 AsamMessageBoxActionHandlers 的 confirm/cancel/close，在 VNode 内提供业务按钮，三种动作仍经过 beforeClose 并驱动同一个 Promise。distinguishCancelAndClose=true 时分别拒绝 cancel 和 close；confirm 解析确认结果，prompt 返回 action/value。beforeClose 使用 done 完成异步确认，不调用则保持打开；callback 是回调模式。inputValidator/inputPattern/inputErrorMessage 负责输入校验。close 为全局清理，原生语义不保证结算所有存活 Promise，因此不能用它替代业务 cancel，也不要在共存示例卸载时无条件调用。

关联组件

对话框 AsamDialog气泡确认 AsamPopconfirm

保留 Promise 操作、输入提示值、回调及 beforeClose 事务状态。

AsamMessageBox 公开类型视图
ts
import type { AppContext, App, AppConfig, ComponentOptions, ComponentProvideOptions, Component, ComputedOptions, MethodOptions, Directive } from 'vue';
import type { AsamMessageBoxActionHandlers, AsamMessageBoxService, AsamMessageBoxShortcut, AsamMessageBoxOptions, AsamMessageBoxData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamMessageBox
type PublicContract = {
	(options: AsamMessageBoxOptions, appContext?: AppContext | null | undefined): Promise<AsamMessageBoxData>;
	"close": AsamMessageBoxActionHandlers["confirm"];
	"_context": AppContext | null;
	"alert": AsamMessageBoxShortcut;
	"confirm": AsamMessageBoxShortcut;
	"prompt": AsamMessageBoxShortcut;
	"install": (app: App) => void;
};

inputPattern

必填：否；声明来源：上游声明。

inputPattern 参数与事件数据

下列为声明可读视图；可导入类型以公开类型视图为准。分支条件与父属性一致。

  • inputPattern.exec: (string: string) => RegExpExecArray | null — 依赖声明

    使用正则表达式检索字符串，返回匹配结果数组。

    事件参数：(string: string): RegExpExecArray | null

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.test: (string: string) => boolean — 依赖声明

    返回布尔值，表示被检索字符串是否包含匹配模式。

    事件参数：(string: string): boolean

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.source: string — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式模式文本的只读副本；regExp 参数为正则对象，可以使用变量或字面量。

  • inputPattern.global: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 global（g）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.ignoreCase: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 ignoreCase（i）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.multiline: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 multiline（m）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.lastIndex: number — 依赖声明
  • inputPattern.compile: (pattern: string, flags?: string) => RegExp — 依赖声明

    事件参数：(pattern: string, flags?: string | undefined): RegExp

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.flags: string — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式标志的只读字符串，按 g（全局）、i（忽略大小写）、m（多行）、u（Unicode）、y（粘连）顺序排列；未设置标志时为空字符串。

  • inputPattern.sticky: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 sticky（y）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.unicode: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 Unicode（u）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.dotAll: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 dotAll（s）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.hasIndices: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 hasIndices（d）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.__@match@554192: (string: string) => RegExpMatchArray | null — 依赖声明

    使用此正则表达式匹配字符串，并返回包含匹配结果的数组。

    事件参数：(string: string): RegExpMatchArray | null

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.__@replace@554194: { (string: string, replaceValue: string): string; (string: string, replacer: (substring: string, ...args: any[]) => string): string; } — 依赖声明

    使用此正则表达式替换字符串中的文本。

    事件参数：(string: string, replaceValue: string): string

    事件参数：(string: string, replacer: (substring: string, ...args: any[]) => string): string

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.__@search@554197: (string: string) => number — 依赖声明

    返回使用此正则表达式检索时，首个匹配子串的起始位置。

    事件参数：(string: string): number

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.__@split@554199: (string: string, limit?: number) => string[] — 依赖声明

    使用与此正则匹配的内容分隔原始字符串，返回子串数组；若含捕获组，每次匹配的捕获结果也会插入数组，包括 undefined 结果。

    事件参数：(string: string, limit?: number | undefined): string[]

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.__@matchAll@554201: (str: string) => RegExpStringIterator<RegExpExecArray> — 依赖声明

    使用此正则表达式匹配字符串，并返回包含匹配结果的可迭代对象。

    事件参数：(str: string): RegExpStringIterator<RegExpExecArray>

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

inputPattern

必填：是；声明来源：上游声明。

inputPattern 参数与事件数据

下列为声明可读视图；可导入类型以公开类型视图为准。分支条件与父属性一致。

  • inputPattern.exec: (string: string) => RegExpExecArray | null — 依赖声明

    使用正则表达式检索字符串，返回匹配结果数组。

    事件参数：(string: string): RegExpExecArray | null

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.test: (string: string) => boolean — 依赖声明

    返回布尔值，表示被检索字符串是否包含匹配模式。

    事件参数：(string: string): boolean

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.source: string — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式模式文本的只读副本；regExp 参数为正则对象，可以使用变量或字面量。

  • inputPattern.global: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 global（g）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.ignoreCase: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 ignoreCase（i）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.multiline: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 multiline（m）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.lastIndex: number — 依赖声明
  • inputPattern.compile: (pattern: string, flags?: string) => RegExp — 依赖声明

    事件参数：(pattern: string, flags?: string | undefined): RegExp

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.flags: string — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式标志的只读字符串，按 g（全局）、i（忽略大小写）、m（多行）、u（Unicode）、y（粘连）顺序排列；未设置标志时为空字符串。

  • inputPattern.sticky: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 sticky（y）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.unicode: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 Unicode（u）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.dotAll: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 dotAll（s）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.hasIndices: boolean — 依赖声明

    返回正则表达式 hasIndices（d）标志的只读布尔状态，默认为 false。

    枚举：false / true

  • inputPattern.__@match@554192: (string: string) => RegExpMatchArray | null — 依赖声明

    使用此正则表达式匹配字符串，并返回包含匹配结果的数组。

    事件参数：(string: string): RegExpMatchArray | null

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.__@replace@554194: { (string: string, replaceValue: string): string; (string: string, replacer: (substring: string, ...args: any[]) => string): string; } — 依赖声明

    使用此正则表达式替换字符串中的文本。

    事件参数：(string: string, replaceValue: string): string

    事件参数：(string: string, replacer: (substring: string, ...args: any[]) => string): string

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.__@search@554197: (string: string) => number — 依赖声明

    返回使用此正则表达式检索时，首个匹配子串的起始位置。

    事件参数：(string: string): number

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.__@split@554199: (string: string, limit?: number) => string[] — 依赖声明

    使用与此正则匹配的内容分隔原始字符串，返回子串数组；若含捕获组，每次匹配的捕获结果也会插入数组，包括 undefined 结果。

    事件参数：(string: string, limit?: number | undefined): string[]

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • inputPattern.__@matchAll@554201: (str: string) => RegExpStringIterator<RegExpExecArray> — 依赖声明

    使用此正则表达式匹配字符串，并返回包含匹配结果的可迭代对象。

    事件参数：(str: string): RegExpStringIterator<RegExpExecArray>

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。
